name: Frog Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and let your knees open comfortably to the sides.
Place your fingertips lightly behind your ears with your elbows wide and your lower back settled toward the floor.
Contract your abs to curl your head, shoulders, and upper back up off the floor toward your pelvis.
Pause briefly at the top of the crunch, then lower your shoulders slowly back down to the floor.
tips: Support your head lightly without pulling your chin into your chest with your hands.
Exhale as you curl up and focus on flexing your spine rather than using momentum.
